sources.name: Flightradar24 public airport schedule JSON (operating day 2026-10-11 JST)
Flightradar24 public airport schedule data (KIX/HND/NRT/ITM, departures+arrivals)
sources.notes: Pulled the public JSON behind the airport pages (api.flightradar24.com/common/v1/airport.json, no login) for 2026-10-11 JST (Sunday). Gives scheduled time, flight number, ADS-B callsign, aircraft ICAO type and registration. Only flights that actually operated (registration present, not cancelled) were selected, so type is verified.

sources.name: Avionio live departures/arrivals boards
sources.notes: Second source for flight number + scheduled time (same date). Flights matched are tagged in source. Avionio was sampled hourly (first page only), so a missing match does not mean the flight is not real.

notes: All flights operated on 2026-10-11 (JST) at KIX/HND/NRT/ITM/UKB. Times are scheduled local times. Callsigns as broadcast unless csDerived=true. All flights are from one real operating day, Sunday 2026-10-11 (JST); weekday schedules differ slightly. Times are SCHEDULED local times (STD for DEP, STA for ARR) at the airport in question. type = the aircraft actually used that day (FR24 ICAO designator, e.g. B77L also covers 777F freighters, B748 covers 747-8F); other days may use a different type on the same flight. Callsigns are taken from ADS-B as shown by FR24. When FR24 showed an IATA-style placeholder (e.g. 'JL610') the ICAO callsign was derived and noted. Findings: Skymark pads callsigns (SKY002); JAL sometimes uses alphanumeric (JAL373C); J-Air flies under JAL callsigns; Air Japan flies NH801/802 as AJX; IBEX uses IBX+FW number. The user's telephony list was mostly right except Spring Japan (JEY SPRING, not J-BIRD); Doc 8585 spellings are JAPANAIR, NEWSKY, KOREANAIR, TWAYAIR. Airline fleet lists only contain types seen at these 4 airports on that day, so they are not complete fleets. Selection was spread across the day by hourly traffic share, choosing carriers round-robin. KIX includes some overnight Chinese cargo (SC/CF/GI). NRT includes NCA and Western Global cargo. RJOO = all 60 HND-ITM flights FR24 listed that day (JAL and ANA, about 15 each way per airline). ITM has a 07:00-21:00 curfew. HND sample has 120 flights (extra international added) while KIX/NRT have about 95.
